scripts.build: node scripts/quality/tracked-tree.mjs -- pnpm exec turbo build
scripts.ci:pr: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm quality:static && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build:ci && pnpm bundle:check && pnpm diff:check
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names web,convex,gateway --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "pnpm --filter web dev" "pnpm exec convex dev" "pnpm --filter @zevium/gateway dev"
scripts.lint: node scripts/quality/check-turbo-lint.mjs && turbo lint && pnpm lint:repo
scripts.lint:repo: oxlint --config .oxlintrc.json --deny-warnings --report-unused-disable-directives --no-ignore --disable-nested-config convex .github/scripts scripts/seed.ts scripts/quality/build-ci.mjs scripts/quality/check-bundles.mjs scripts/quality/check-generated-routes.mjs scripts/quality/check-gitleaks.mjs scripts/quality/check-structured-data.mjs scripts/quality/check-test-focus.mjs scripts/quality/check-turbo-lint.mjs scripts/quality/check-workflow-toolchains.mjs scripts/quality/quality.test.mjs scripts/quality/run-tests-ci.mjs scripts/quality/source-inventory.mjs scripts/quality/tracked-tree.mjs
scripts.quality:static: pnpm quality:structured && pnpm quality:toolchains && pnpm quality:tests && pnpm quality:actions && pnpm quality:shell && pnpm quality:gitleaks
